results.title: Did RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra Walk out of Doordarshan's 'DD Morning Show'? Here Is the Truth
results.description: PIB Fact Check debunked viral claims that RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra walked out of Doordarshan's 'DD Morning Show'. PIB said that the viral images and reports are AI-generated scams designed to redirect users to fraudulent investment platforms. It confirmed that Doordarshan did not host Sanjay Malhotra.
